name: Take email and mobile only from a tel/mailto link or a labelled contact field of this profile, and clean contaminated numbers already saved
request: Take email and mobile only from a tel/mailto link or a labelled contact field of this profile, and clean contaminated numbers already saved
checks: npm run check passed (typecheck, build, 295 tests, validate)
result: Email and mobile now need provenance. A number is taken only from a tel: link or a labelled Phone/Mobile field; an address only from a mailto: link or a labelled Email field. extraction-core scrubs URLs, addresses and word-welded identifiers before PHONE_PATTERN ever runs and normalizePhone rejects anything containing a path, an @ or a host, which is what stops a vanity URL's member id (linkedin.com/in/paarth-khandelwal-264954380 -> 264954380) becoming a mobile number. scanLabelledContacts replaced the whole-page sweep, so the Interests block's Top Voices no longer put a stranger's email and phone on the record; content.js also rejects any link inside a foreign section or a card that links to a different member. Records already saved self-heal: normalizeProfile drops a phone contained in its own profile URL's digits, db.repairStoredProfiles writes those rows back on dashboard load, and a Clean shared contacts button removes any value found on three or more different people.
